# Interview P3
Participant: P3
Role: Founder
Date: 2026-09-10
Segment: Small team
Method: interview

Q: What slows you down when you use agents?
P3: I explain our architecture again every single morning.
P3: Context doesn't carry over from one session to the next.
Q: How do you check what the agent did?
P3: If I could accept parts of it, I would use it more.
P3: Right now it's all or nothing, so I usually say nothing.
Q: What makes you comfortable letting it run?
P3: Seeing its cursor move on a shared board makes it feel like a teammate.
Q: Anything you wish you had?
P3: One place where decisions and their reasons stay put.
